h:
将卡通转换为真实的简单工作流程。我没有创造这个。
Controlnet 是 Union XL


V1。 ：简单流程，使用控制网络进行图像到图像。请务必添加提示，以帮助其更接近您想要看到的内容。

V2：我添加了面部细节师和劳拉。这会给您带来一点提升，特别是当您希望将角色 lora 应用于输出时。

o.en:
Simple workflow to convert a toon to real. I did not create this.
Controlnet is Union XL


V1. : Simple flow, image to image using the control net. Be sure to put in prompts to help get it closer to what you want to see.

V2: I added in a face detailer and a lora. This gives you a little boost especially if you're looking to apply a character lora to the output.
